title: precheck's windowed-detector warning has a test that reads the printed line, not the source text
goal: Found by the SP-m3azo2y7 review of BG-rn4pt6bb and BG-cb4wcm2m: nothing in the suite names precheck or windowed_detector, and BG-rn4pt6bb's repro slices bl_land.py from def windowed_detector to def cmd_precheck, a slice whose docstring already holds "main's tip", so reverting the warning string alone passes it. One planted-failure assertion, within the ceiling in _tools/tests_ceiling.json (folded into an existing scenario while the suite sits at 100 ids), runs precheck on a sprint whose bug's repro is the intake --status of the trailers detector and asserts the warning line names the bug and says the window follows main's tip.
